# Vigilante — Competitive Intelligence

> AI-powered competitor monitoring: 3 agents watch pricing, SEC filings, hiring pages, and product changes. Daily briefs from $10/mo.

## What it does
- Discovers competitor URLs (pricing, IR, careers, governance)
- Snapshots and diffs pages on a schedule
- Monitors SEC EDGAR for public companies
- Writes sourced daily intelligence briefs
- Slack alerts and multi-tenant workspaces

## Pricing
- Free: 2 agents
- Growth: 3 AI agents — $10/mo (promo VIGILANTE = 50% off)
- Team: 6+ agents — $20/mo
